policies.B1: A device meets foundational production safety norms when it completes a minimum of 100 test flight hours per year while holding an ISO 9001 quality certificate.
policies.B2: An equipment model is granted commercial deployment status for heavy-duty uses if it fulfills foundational production safety norms and carries a maximum payload weight capacity of at least 20 kg.
policies.D1: Authorization for the EU Commercial Fleet Listing is conferred when a candidate has commercial deployment status for heavy-duty uses and holds third-party liability insurance coverage of at least $3,000,000 in a year.
policies.B3: Designation under the High-Output Energy Tier is awarded to panels providing a peak power output of 400 W or greater.
policies.B4: An apparatus satisfies all-weather submersion standards provided that it maintains an IP68 ingress protection rating.

decoy_policies: An industrial chiller obtains Green Ventilation Certification if it records an annual seasonal performance ratio of at least 15 and maintains an operational noise level under 50 dB.
An industrial battery system qualifies for Grid Reserve Status when its nominal storage capacity exceeds 500 kWh.

B1: Apex Drone X1 completed 120 test flight hours this year, meeting the 100-hour threshold, and maintains an ISO 9001 quality certificate, fulfilling baseline manufacturing safety criteria.
B2: Apex Drone X1 fulfills baseline manufacturing safety criteria and features a maximum payload weight capacity of 25 kg, exceeding the 20 kg minimum required for heavy-duty commercial deployment authorization.
D1: Apex Drone X1 holds heavy-duty commercial deployment authorization and maintains $5,000,000 in third-party liability insurance coverage, exceeding the $3,000,000 requirement for EU Commercial Fleet Listing.
B3: Solis Solar Panel Model S4 produces a peak power output of 450 W, satisfying the 400 W requirement for High-Output Energy Tier designation.
B4: Vortex Water Pump V2 holds an IP68 ingress protection rating, fulfilling all-weather submersion criteria.
